answers.question: level L1 (Footbridge over tracks 1–4): height not measured
answers.answer: Still open: no source measures the deck; the laser gives only the footbridge roof/top (see the structures file).

answers.question: no entrances mapped
answers.answer: Partly: the map shows the station building on the west side (Centralgatan) and the footbridge ends on both sides as the ways in; it marks no named entrances or doors.
answers._source: Länstrafiken Kronoberg, "Avgångsplatser och service, Alvesta station" (map PDF valid from 2023-12-10, linked from Jernhusen's Alvesta page), read 2026-10-30; facts only

open: Entrance doors of the station building (names, which street): not on the map and not in OSM.
The map is from December 2023; OSM also has escalators at the footbridge (w1391134003–6) that the map does not show.
